text:
aj: starting bootstrap/handoff for eu9 (codename: boreal). Goal: project, VNet, per-AZ NATs, GPU subnets, and basic IAM ready for Dedicated team by EOD Fri.

maria: quick ask — do we have provider SKU inventory for eu9? I'm not seeing A100 listed and need that for quota ticket.

leo: checked provider portal: no A100 zones yet. They've got some A10G/RTX stock. We should prepare a firm fallback plan (zone routing + promo test pool).

sophia: fallback policy: if A100 not provisionable within 48h, route production pools to eu8, and allow eu9 for dev/best-effort. Document SLA delta. :warning:

katie: infra-bot: create project and enable infra APIs. Module: terraform/projects, env: prod.

infra-bot: created project rw-boreal-eu9 (proj-id: rw-boreal-eu9). Enabled APIs: compute.googleapis.com, cloudkms.googleapis.com, logging.googleapis.com, iam.googleapis.com. Billing linked to acct B-998.

aj: VNet CIDR proposal (finalize if no conflicts): 10.244.0.0/16 region VNet, split as:
- 10.244.0.0/19 control-plane (small services, jumpbox)
- 10.244.32.0/19 gpu-pool-a (AZ a primary)
- 10.244.64.0/19 gpu-pool-b (AZ b primary)
- 10.244.96.0/20 infra-services (monitoring, kube-controllers)
- 10.244.112.0/20 dev-nonprod

maria: add tags: { team: inference, region: eu9, env: prod, cost-center: inference-prod } and annotate in address registry.

leo: note: provider requires NAT gateway per zone when using private google access for GPUs. We'll deploy autoscaling NATs and a small HA pair for control-plane.

sophia: IAM: create role redwood.inference.gpuNode with: compute.instances.get, compute.instances.list, storage.objects.get, kms.decrypt. Attach to service account compute-sa-inference-eu9. We'll limit on resource:projects/rw-boreal-eu9.

katie: pushing terraform snippet to infra repo: branch boreal/eu9-scaffold. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3180 (includes VPC module, nat-gateway module, iam role, kms key ring).

aj: validation checklist before Dedicated handoff (short):
1) project + APIs (done)
2) VNet + subnets + route tables created
3) per-AZ NATs deployed + egress smoke
4) IAM role + node SA created
5) KMS key ring and key created + sample encrypt/decrypt test
6) GPU quota request submitted (ticket link)
7) Monthly cost estimate attached to PR
8) Tagging and billing labels verified

maria: opened quota ticket SUP-99821 requesting 12 A100s (preferred) + fallback 24 A10G. Asked for zone-level split and ETA.

leo: network smoke test plan (I'll run):
- spin tiny VM in control-plane subnet, confirm metadata and DNS
- from gpu subnet, simulate model pull to storage.pub and test outbound to internal pacifier endpoint through NAT
- verify route tables and firewall rules
- verify VPC flow logs are producing entries to central logging
Commands I'll run: `gcloud compute instances create test-smoke --zone=eu9-a --subnet=control-plane --image-family=debian-11` and `gcloud compute routes list --filter="network:rw-boreal-eu9"`.

sophia: Security: enable VPC Flow Logs for every GPU subnet, retention 30d, sink to logging project via pubsub. Also enforce private GKE endpoint if we run clusters.

katie: cost snapshot in PR: baseline infra (no GPUs) ~$1.4k/mo. If 12xA100 on-demand ~ $62k/mo; with committed reserved ~ $45k/mo. Egress to APAC could add $3-7k depending on traffic. Finance flagged need for provisional approval.

aj: handoff owner: leo. After he marks checklist green, tag @capacity-team. Capacity team should wait for SUP-99821 quota confirmation before scheduling reserved pools.

leo: terraform plan completed locally. Pushed plan output in PR. plan id: p-20240202-eu9-01. No destructive changes.

maria: provider support asked for AZ distribution numbers. @aj please confirm planned AZ spread.

aj: suggested AZ distribution: eu9-a: 6xA100, eu9-b: 4xA100, eu9-c: fallback A10G pool (12). If provider can only supply A10G, we'll reduce A100 counts and shift traffic. I'll update ticket SUP-99821.

provisioner-bot: SUP-99821 updated with AZ distribution. Status: pending.

sophia: schedule 30m sync with capacity + security tomorrow 09:00 UTC to review fallback, KMS access, and tagging for auditing.

katie: finance pre-approved up to $55k provisional for first month if quota clears. Noted in PR comments.

leo: smoke tests ✅. Metadata ok, NAT egress from GPU subnet ok, flow logs writing. Marking checklist items 2,3,5 as done. Waiting on SUP-99821 and finance final.

maria: ticket updated: provider asked for forecasted sustained utilization per AZ (avg tokens/sec). @aj can you provide expected steady-state utilization for sizing?

aj: estimate: with 10k qps equivalent per A100 at our model mix, expected steady-state 30% utilization across pools initially; will include a small buffer. I'll attach a spreadsheet to the ticket.

infra-bot: terraform apply succeeded for rw-boreal-eu9 VPC and NAT modules (apply id: a-20240202-eu9). Outputs: vpc_self_link, subnets list.

leo: final note for runbook entry: include step-by-step rollback plan:
- If quota denied, tag rw-boreal-eu9 as dev-only, and provision prod pools in eu8.
- DNS/edge routing changes: update routing policy in smart-router to divert eu9 production traffic to eu8 variant.
- Communicate to customers with expected cutover window.

aj: creating runbook PR under docs/runbooks/region-eu9-boreal.md with checklists, smoke commands, and ownership. Will @mention capacity and sec teams when ready.

leo: tagging capacity-team — you're up after SUP-99821 clears. I'll add runbook links to PR.

aj: closing this bootstrap thread. Follow-ups will be in Dedicated onboarding channel and the runbook PR. :rocket:
